hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in *_Complete_*.md|*_Complete*.md) CHARS=$(echo -n "$CONTENT" | wc -m | tr -d ' '); if [ "$CHARS" -lt 100000 ]; then echo "BLOCK: Complete文件${CHARS}字符 < 100K底线。请扩写后重试。" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac

hooks.comment: 检查md文件中的断链引用
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in *.md) grep -oE '`(docs/[^`]+|[A-Z]+\.md|\.claude/skills/[^`]+)`' "$FP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '`' | while read ref; do [ ! -f "$ref" ] && echo "WARNING: 断链引用 $ref 在 $FP 中" || true; done || true ;; esac; true

INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in */reports/*.md) case "$FP" in */reports/*/[A-Z]*) echo "✓ 报告路径正确: $FP" ;; *) echo "WARNING: 铁律E违反 — 报告应放入 reports/{TICKER}/ 子目录" ;; esac || true ;; esac; true

hooks.comment: Sprint 3: Complete文件写入后自动生成无痕化版本 (_seamless.md)
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in *_seamless.md) exit 0 ;; *_Complete_*.md|*_Complete*.md) if [ -f "$FP" ] && [ -x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/seamless_translator.sh" ]; then bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/seamless_translator.sh" "$FP" >&2 2>&1 || echo "WARNING: seamless_translator失败 (非阻断)" >&2; fi ;; esac; exit 0
